## What this contributes

Describe the competition or research scope, the change, and why it is useful.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug or maintenance fix
- [ ] Reproduction or evaluation record
- [ ] Provenance, license, or data-boundary correction
- [ ] Research method, tool, or documentation
- [ ] New archive or artifact release
- [ ] Post-publication correction or withdrawal

## Evidence

List the command or notebook entry point, revision, environment, data/model versions, seed, metric, and relevant receipts. State whether the result is a plan, exploration, candidate result, reproduced result, or archive update.

## Boundaries

- [ ] I checked credentials and private identifiers are absent.
- [ ] I recorded provenance for added data, models, or third-party material.
- [ ] Redistribution is permitted, or the artifact is represented only by a manifest/link.
- [ ] Official inputs and third-party material remain separately attributed and within their terms.
- [ ] If this changes a release or public artifact, I listed its version/tag, checksums, and replacement/removal impact.
- [ ] I kept unrelated generated files and formatting changes out of this contribution.

## Limitations

Document failures, uncertainty, missing assets, and what was not verified.

If this pull request concerns sensitive material, stop and use the private
route in `SECURITY.md` instead of describing it here.
